steps.note: SELECT * returns system columns first, then data columns.
A frontmatter key named _path stays reachable through _data.
A non-identifier key is a quoted identifier.
_present is 0 for a file with no metadata block.
Each collection is a view of its globs' files.
A file whose own $schema outranks its override is still a member.
Views may overlap.
A collection view is read-only, exit 2.
SET k = NULL removes the key.
A paired SET renames a key.
A _path move may not change the extension.
explicit_null() writes a literal null.
DELETE strips the frontmatter block.
System columns other than _path are read-only.
--check implies the dry run: pending changes are findings.
A declared format name previews as the property the schema gains.
A CHECK (k IN (...)) becomes an enum.
DDL on the built-in default set refuses.
-s names the DDL target set directly.
-s on a statement with no schema effect refuses.
An unbound named parameter is refused.
path/key/lineFor/message columns become a GitHub annotation.
A findings format without --check is refused.
CSV emits a header row; arrays stay JSON text.
CSV refuses a statement that produced changes.
ATTACH is refused.
A second statement is refused.
A write cannot touch <stdin>.
